Class RcxRegulatedPair

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxRegulatedPair
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegulatedPair
public final class RcxRegulatedPair extends Object implements RegulatedPair
The A and C outputs of an RCX regulated by its own firmware, with their rotation sensors on inputs 1 and 3, driven as one pair: a movement sets both wheels' targets in a single infrared command, and the brick regulates both on its own between commands.

The pair owns the session, the motion IDs, the profile and the cached status; its two left() and right() handles are views over it. Positions are sensor steps (16 per sensor revolution) converted to encoder-shaft degrees using sensorStepsPerMotorRevolution; a movement smaller than one step cannot be represented and is rejected. Create the pair once at startup and reuse it.

    • DEFAULT_BRAKE_LEAD

      public static final int DEFAULT_BRAKE_LEAD
      The brake lead a pair arms with, in the brick's control cycles (333 a second). Measured on the reference build at power 1 on batteries (about 13 cycles a step): its 500 mm moves stopped on 31 and 32 of 31 steps; on a power bank, at about 10 cycles a step, on 33, since a faster wheel coasts further than its speed times the lead.
      See Also:

  • Constructor Details

    • RcxRegulatedPair

      public RcxRegulatedPair(RcxLink link, int session, int configurationFlags, int sensorStepsPerMotorRevolution)
      Creates a pair for session (1..255) over an infrared link that has a receiver, since every regulated command is answered. configurationFlags holds the INVERT_* and BRAKE_ON_STOP bits and the maximum motor power (0..7) in bits 5-7. sensorStepsPerMotorRevolution is the sensor's steps per 360 degrees of motor shaft.

  • Method Details

    • maxPower

      public static int maxPower(int level)
      The configuration bits for a maximum motor power of level (1 to 7, full power is 7), to OR into the configuration flags. A pair with no maximum power would never move, so the constructor rejects one.

    • setMaxPower

      public void setMaxPower(int level)
      Sets the maximum motor power, 1 to 7, keeping the other configuration flags. The brick receives the configuration when the pair is armed, so the new power applies from the next arm(); rejected while the pair moves.

    • maxPower

      public int maxPower()
      The configured maximum motor power, 1 to 7, as the next arm() sends it.

    • setBrakeLead

      public void setBrakeLead(int cycles)
      Sets the brake lead, in the brick's control cycles (333 a second), 0 to 255: each wheel brakes early by the distance it coasts at its current speed, which is its speed times this lead, so the wheels stop on their targets instead of past them. 0 brakes only on the target. The brick receives it when the pair is armed, so it applies from the next arm(). Tune it on the floor: raise it while moves overshoot, lower it while they stop short.

    • arm

      public void arm()
      Arms the session: the brick reconfigures its sensors, clears its motion history and faults, and reports RcxRegulatedState.READY. Positions are measured from here, so each side's tachometer starts at zero. Arming is the recovery after a latched fault and needs both outputs safe.

    • rotate

      public void rotate(int leftDegrees, int rightDegrees, boolean immediateReturn)
      Starts one coordinated movement: the left and right sides each move relative to their current position, by their degrees, in the same infrared command. Refreshes the status first, sends the profile, then starts. Waits for completion unless immediateReturn is set.
      Specified by:
      rotate in interface RegulatedPair
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the pair is not ready to start, or the brick rejects or cannot answer the start
      IllegalArgumentException - if a side's movement is out of range or quantizes to zero

    • waitComplete

      public void waitComplete()
      Polls the status until the movement completes or latches an error. Gives up after the movement's timeout plus a margin and reports RcxRegulatedState.LINK_UNKNOWN, since the brick should have finished by then.
      Specified by:
      waitComplete in interface RegulatedPair
